summary: Hardened the tier-20 verifier with 7 anti-fabrication gates (test-only, package e2e over frozen agent-brain.e2e.v1): manifest-present (non-run provenance), within time-window (stale/cumulative), exact 20-task-set (fabricated/extra), exact 7-hop cardinality (inflation/missing/dup), real proc_id>0 tied to a daemon-launched process (sentinel/synthetic rejected), no generated <prefix><task_id> IDs (SyntheticTraceSpans rejected), 20 unique persisted outcomes (dup/lost). RAN: accept-real fixture passes all gates; 9 fabrication vectors each rejected by their gate. Encodes that synthetic /tmp fixtures and the deterministic-barrier run cannot pass REAL acceptance (fail real-proc + generated-id gates).

fixtures built in-memory, never read from /tmp (hardening posture)
reuses frozen agent-brain.e2e.v1 public Assemble/EmittingHops/Correlation.Get; no new product contract; manifest+gates are verifier-local test types

verifies anti-fabrication of trace/concurrency/persistence-accounting evidence only; NOT LLM/OmniRoute protocol behavior; no model-route acceptance; no inference/deploy; does not authorize 9.2/tiers/cutover
